purpose: Shared deterministic keyword-extraction rules for dated corpora. Temporal classification is applied from the Current ERA registry without transferring source Scope ownership.
rules: Prefer existing semantic_keywords/keywords/tags when present; otherwise extract deterministic CJK 2-4 grams and Latin words from text.
Count document frequency separately from total hit count.
Store source/date independently from ERA. ERA aggregation must use the latest Current ERA registry boundaries at query time.
Keyword/statistics Features consume a governed Scope without taking ownership of its records.
Do not hard-code Top 10 terms or ERA results.
Historical LOC1–8 identifiers may be retained only as provenance; they cannot define Current authority.
